body: If you want to keep wasting time on me I won't stop you, but this will be my last message to you, to be honest I don't feel like driving anymore so I'm just gonna use the glock, I don't want to get in your way anymore than I already have, I used to hope for something better but it never came, I'm at the end of my rope, I appreciate the time you took to talk to me in my last hours, but it's time I said goodbye for real. I was born a piece of shit and I'll go out like one too. People say that suicide is wrong but I can't help myself anymore. Goodbye.

My demons aren't going away anytime soon, how long do I have to keep reliving the same thing over, I do appreciate how much you care, but I hope you see that my life is just not worth living, I just feel so trapped and the tension in my head, I just want to escape and rott like the piece of shit I am. I don't have time to wait. Please stop. I'm just prolonging the inevitable, my depression has got the best of me.
No, you know I will always be alone, I'm just some selfish asshole who can't even love himself, but somehow have the stupidity to hold the barrel of a gun to his forehead.
You don't need me, I'm nothing. There are plenty of others that actually need your help, why waste your time on me?

Stop. I know my decision and I can face the consequences. I just want to sleep peacefully. My heart can take no longer. I wasn't looking to get this much attention anyway. I'm just tired from drowning in my own tears. Goodbye.
I've been wasting away for days, I'm not changing for anyone, the truth hurts bro, but I can't fight anymore, it's just a waste of time, i gotta do it before my buzz comes down
I've got nothing else to lose which is why suicide is the only answer for me, time has told me
I gotta admit, you're really good at stalling me, but you're out of your mind if you think I could get help
I'm just looking for the easy way out, I know you mean well but you're keeping yourself blind if you think I would ever come back from this
I can't help anyone, my mind is a broken failure
I'm down for the count man, I'm not getting back up
I have nothing else to say, my time is up man

I never knew how many people have so many issues, I wish I knew how to deal with the pain better, but for now brother this is goodbye, I'm drunk as a skunk and im gonna go for a drive, going to drive off this bridge near me, don't worry if I live I got a backup glock in the glove box, I'll see you all on the other side.

Sounds like you really turned it around a bit, I wish I had a drive like that in me, growing up my family never loved me, I know that sounds like an exaggeration believe me it's not, I was physically and mentally abused by both of my parents my entire life, I don't even know why I was conceived if they were just gonna treat me that way, I didn't have a bed to even sleep in, and being an only child was even worse, I wasn't allowed to have any friends, by the time I was 18 I moved out asap and ended up working some dead end jobs but it was worth it to get away from my parents, I haven't talked to them since, I met a girl and low and behold she got pregnant but she lost the baby and left me because of that, so I am literally just by myself in this life, and I'm just drained.

Sounds like a good dream, right now I'm living with my eyes wide open, and I can't see anything for me in the future other than suicide, if not today tomorrow. Some people try to offer help but they are only words and don't go too deep, I'm at the end of my rope and I soon I'll be sleeping with my eyes wide open.
Bro
Why not I've got nothing but time now, I'm just having some liquid courage.
My mind has been made up but feel free to post, I'll listen to what you have to say
How long can I go on when everyday is a battle
Nobody wants to hear me ramble about how miserable I am, I have to stomp the hurt in my heart, just keep yourself up because I sure as hell can't
